It sees your staged edits. If the answer says partial, narrow it with path and glob. Very long patterns and nested repeats are refused.

function.name: read_page

function.name: research

function.name: find_resources

function.name: flag_finding
function.description: Record something you noticed outside your task (a bug, a security problem, dead code) for the pull request. Do not fix it unless the task includes it.

function.name: note
function.description: Write a line in the work log for the reviewer: a decision and why.

function.name: ask_user
function.description: Ask the person a question, only when you cannot go on without the answer; the job waits. Give `options` (up to 4 short choices) when you can.

function.name: done
